Research programme · 02

AI Governance: Data Safety & Content Integrity

How do we keep data-driven systems reliable when data can be poisoned, biased, noisy, or private?

Security and governance at the data layer: poisoning and backdoors, algorithmic bias, privacy leakage, and defensible data use.

Data poisoningAlgorithmic fairnessPrivacy protectionData governance

Research focus

Three questions shape this programme.

This is the working agenda: a precise statement of the problems the lab is building toward, not a claim that every component is already solved.

01

Poisoning & backdoors

Reveal how manipulated samples, labels, and physical triggers can redirect learning or downstream behaviour.

02

Bias & fair generation

Measure and mitigate systematic disparities in generative and predictive systems.

03

Privacy-preserving adaptation

Reduce information leakage while retaining the practical value of fine-tuning and collaborative learning.
